Name: Super Recipes
Author: KanDa312
Description:
This mod add 2 new recipes called Super Drink and Super Food to the game.
You will automatically get them once you installed this mod. Both need the same ingredient.

I created this recipes just for fun because i wanted to get all the buffs, currently i didnt plan to add more recipes in this mod.
I draw the art myself, i know it looks ugly because i cant draw it so im sorry for that. But its just for fun so.... T_T
As a bonus, I also make those recipes as [b]universal love[/b].

Each of those recipe contain the following buffs:
+10 Farming ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
+10 Fishing ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
+10 Mining
+10 Luck
+10 Foraging
+300 Max Energy
+256 Magnetism
+10 Speed
+10 Defense
+10 Attack

[b]
Config:[/b]
You can enabled or disabled this mod by using Generic Mod Config Menu.
Or manually by editing config.json using text editor, set it from "True" to "False". By default its set to "True".


[b]How to install this mod:[/b]
1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download and extract to "Mods" folder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download and extract to "Mods" folder [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional)
4. Extract this mod to "Mods" folder.
